name: GitLab
headquarters: None in practice (all-remote); San Francisco, CA listed as corporate address
business_model: Open core; per-seat subscriptions plus usage-based GitLab Credits for AI
mission: Enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world
self_description: The intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps
deployment_options: GitLab Dedicated (Single-tenant SaaS for regulated enterprises)

ai_strategy.model_neutrality: Supports Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT models, GLM, and self-hosted open models
ai_strategy.data_privacy: Zero data retention for code suggestions; customer-managed self-hosted gateway keeps data fully local/air-gapped
ai_strategy.commercial_model: Usage-based virtual currency (GitLab Credits) at ~$1/credit with bundled monthly promotional allowances on Premium ($12/user) and Ultimate ($24/user)

act_2.theme: Governed software creation in the Agentic Era
core_tenets: Software increasingly built by autonomous AI agents and directed by humans
Agents as first-class users with dedicated APIs
Unified governance, identity, and compliance platform across human and agent workflows
act_2.restructuring: R&D organized into ~60 autonomous teams; flattened management layers

competitive_landscape.gitlab_differentiator: Single unified application and data model across entire lifecycle vs modular multi-tool integrations
End-to-end trace from issue to deployment without external sync plugins
Governed lifecycle-wide orchestration, privacy-first self-hosted options, and multi-model flexibility via AI Gateway

strengths: Single platform and data model spanning planning, code, CI/CD, security, and deployment
Over 50% of the Fortune 100 customer penetration
Cloud and model neutrality with robust air-gapped/self-hosted privacy capabilities
Strong positive cash flow and healthy enterprise retention metrics
risks_and_challenges: Execution and transition risk from Act 2 restructuring and hybrid credit pricing
Intense competitive pressure from Microsoft/GitHub Copilot ecosystem
notes: GitLab is an enterprise AI-powered DevSecOps platform delivered as a single application. Its strategic differentiators are a single data model across the software lifecycle, cloud and AI-model neutrality (multi-model routing via the AI Gateway, including self-hosted models), privacy and governance controls for AI, and a public, handbook-first operating culture. In 2026 it repositioned around the 'agentic era' (Act 2).
